title: Sailor Moon Perler Bead Pattern
about: Partial grids extracted from an AI chat transcript. The PDF does not contain a full-canvas pattern: it gives six focal-area grids plus prose for the rest.

declared.note: First answer; ~122 rows at the thumb tip.
Later 4×4 board plan with 28×28 boards; thumb extends to row 120.

rowFormat: Each row's 'beads' string has one character per bead; look it up in the section's legend. Rows shorter than 'width' are padded on the right with 'padWith' (null = empty/unknown).

hotPink.name: Hot Pink
hotPink.note: Not in the PDF's hex table; approximate value.

boards.summary: Top-left hair cluster. Cols 01–10 solid sky (B); cols 11–28 hair edge with a white/blue dithered halo, Y/O checkerboard inside.
Rows 001–015 solid sky. A white diagonal from (row 16, col 01) to (row 28, col 20) marks the head edge; dithered Y, O and scattered A below.
Cols 01–08 solid sky; cols 09–28 bang tips shifting from Y/O into light pink and peach over the skin.
Left eye (rows 030–044) and nose bridge; rows 045–056 peach/cream checkerboard with light-pink blush.
Right eye (rows 032–046, cols 04–22); cols 23–28 solid midnight shadow block.
Cols 01–10 solid midnight; cols 11–28 back to solid Light Blue.
Upper half cheek dither (peach/pink); lower half hand entering, outlined plum/midnight, filled peach with cream highlights.
Nose base and mouth (scattered pink/magenta); back of the hand and knuckles running diagonally down, cream on the index tendon.
Jawline upper-left; solid Light Blue field lower-right.
Slender diagonal peach fingers with 1-bead plum/midnight outlines on blue; 2×2 cranberry nails around rows 098–104.

sections.title: Left Eye Focal Grid
sections.description: The prominent eye on the left side, from the upper lash arc down through the lower lash spikes.
sections.placement: Board (2,2), roughly rows 030–044 / board columns 05–28 (from the prose).

..note: Legend says 'Background / Skin Base'; skin is the likely surround here.

K.note: Dark Iris / Shadow: Dark Blue, Blueberry, or Dark Purple

M.note: Accent Shadow / Lash Spikes: Hot Pink or Magenta

notes: Declared 24 columns; rows in the PDF are 23 beads wide. Shorter rows are padded on the right with '.' (assumed background).

sections.title: Foreground Hand & Breaking Thumb
sections.description: The hand, with the thumb hanging past the bottom edge of the main canvas.
sections.placement: Bottom-left third; rows 19–24 hang below the canvas edge.

..note: Legend says 'Background / Skin Base'; the hand sits on the blue field.

K.note: Dark Iris / Shadow: Dark Blue, Blueberry, or Dark Purple

M.note: Accent Shadow: Hot Pink or Magenta

O.note: In this legend O is Nail Polish: Bright Red / Cranberry

notes: Declared 22 columns; rows in the PDF are 16, 23 beads wide. Shorter rows are padded on the right with '.' (assumed background).

sections.title: Right Eye & Shadow Block
sections.description: The angled right eye where it meets the deep shadow field on the right edge of the frame.
sections.placement: Board (2,3), with the shadow block running into Board (2,4).

..note: Legend says 'Background / Skin Base'; skin is the likely surround here.

B.note: In this legend B is Solid Deep Shadow: Dark Blue / Blueberry / Dark Purple

K.note: Dark Iris / Eyelash Contour: Midnight Blue / Plum

P.note: Not in this section's legend; carried over from the left-eye legend.

sections.title: Hair Dithering & Bangs Cluster
sections.description: Upper-left quadrant above the eyes: yellow strands, warm orange, and magenta split lines.

..note: Legend says 'Background / Skin Base'; sky is the likely surround at the hair edge.

O.note: In this legend O is Hair Midtone: Cheddar / Orange

M.note: Not in this section's legend; carried over from the earlier legend (Hot Pink / Magenta).

sections.title: Board (1,2): Crown & Bang Core
sections.description: Top-center board: the hair crown, bang roots, and magenta strand lines.
notes: Declared 28 columns; rows in the PDF are 26 beads wide. Shorter rows are padded on the right with empty cells (unknown).

sections.title: Board (4,2): Hand, Fingers & Overhang
sections.description: Bottom-center board: the finger reaching down-left and the thumb extension past the canvas baseline.
sections.placement: Rows 085–120, columns 029–056; rows 113–120 hang below the canvas baseline.

previews.title: Following the PDF
previews.description: Every bead the PDF actually specifies, placed where its prose says it goes: the four positioned grids plus the solid fills it spells out. Hatched areas are only described loosely (e.g. 'dither Y and O') or not at all. The hand and hair-cluster grids have no stated position and are not placed.

previews.title: From the photo
previews.description: The PDF's photo mapped to the nearest bead color at 104×121. The photo is only 82×84 pixels (the piece itself ~48×56), so each pixel covers about four beads: right overall look, no fine detail.
